ns2:course.label: Perf Pract Student Works I
ns2:course.description: Performance laboratory involving the rehearsal and performance of student works under faculty supervision. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. A maximum of 16 hours of performance credit may be counted toward degree requirements.
